Click any element on the page

LaraSelector finds the Blade view and line that render it, then opens it in your editor.

Clickopens the details panel: source, data, queries, route and more
Shift + clickadds the element to a selection you can open or compare
Esccloses the details panel, then stops selecting
⌥ + ⇧ + Lturns selecting on or off

Selecting keeps working while this panel is open, on Laravel apps you run on this computer with the LaraSelector package enabled.
